neighbours.label: a word that introduces a reason or explanation (because, why, porque)
fire: She stayed home from work because she had a fever.
When I saw the broken window I asked him why.
Nobody could explain why the bridge collapsed so suddenly.
Lo decidieron así porque no tenían otra opción.
We love the sea not because it is calm, but because it is vast.
The teacher wanted to know why the homework was late.
They cancelled the match because of the heavy rain.
He finally told me why he had left the city.
quiet: She stayed home from work and watched a film.
When I saw the broken window I called him at once.
Nobody could see the bridge in the thick fog.
Lo decidieron así y se fueron temprano.
We love the sea, and we visit it every summer.
The teacher wanted the homework on her desk by noon.
They cancelled the match on Saturday afternoon.
He finally told me that he had left the city.

notes: Output suppresses ' reasons', ' why', ' explanation': the pole may mark that a reason has just been introduced.
